div.ab:
te´hkunak 'ikähtc'uhki ro´kukati
= the mosquito bit me, it burns
'icitakati
= it itches me (I'm itching)
ta´cilami´lisį 'ikähtc'ɔnasiti ci´takati
= the red bugs bit me, it's itching
ya´ca ya´kati
= it hurts me
tu´huku
= he's pushing
tu´huka´ni
= I'm pushing
lɔ´saka´ni
= I'm pulling
'uwį tu´huwik'ahtca
= ​he's going to push
wi´cita'e´ri
= bucket (water-holder)
ta´wicita'e´ri kal'u´ra
= the bucket's standing
'e´riku
= he's holding
'e´riwik'ahtca
= he's going to hold
'e´riwik'aha
= it doesn't hold
